parameters.query: UPDATE clients SET plan_type = '{{ $json.plan_type }}', config = config || '{"stripe_customer_id": "{{ $json.customer_id }}", "stripe_subscription_id": "{{ $json.subscription_id }}", "billing_status": "active"}'::jsonb, status = 'active' WHERE contact_email = '{{ $json.email }}' OR config->>'stripe_customer_id' = '{{ $json.customer_id }}' RETURNING id, client_code, company_name

UPDATE clients SET status = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' = 'subscription_cancelled' THEN 'churned' WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' = 'payment_failed' THEN 'suspended' ELSE status END, config = config || '{"billing_status": "{{ $json.action === 'payment_failed' ? 'past_due' : $json.action === 'subscription_cancelled' ? 'cancelled' : 'active' }}"}'::jsonb WHERE config->>'stripe_customer_id' = '{{ $json.customer_id }}' RETURNING id, client_code, company_name, status

SELECT log_audit((SELECT id FROM clients WHERE config->>'stripe_customer_id' = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'), 'stripe-billing', '{{ $json.action }}', 'billing', NULL, '{{ JSON.stringify({event_type: $json.event_type, amount: $json.amount, currency: $json.currency, plan: $json.plan_type, status: $json.status}) }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.action === 'payment_failed' ? 'error' : 'success' }}')
